description: Defines complex number types and conversions for the ocudu project, including custom storage type cbf16_t based on 16-bit floating point, and formatting support for complex types.

classes.name: cbf16_t
classes.description: A storage-only complex number type based on 16-bit floating point, with equality operators.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a complex number from one type to another.

methods.name: to_ci8
methods.description: Converts a complex float to complex int8.

methods.name: to_ci16
methods.description: Converts a complex float to complex int16.

methods.name: to_cf
methods.description: Converts various complex types to std::complex<float>.
